criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given HTTP Browsing results are available, when the HTTP Browsing layer is selected, each supplied result is displayed as a selectable point on the map.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-after-add-http.png shows coloured HTTP map points and criterion-1-final.png shows a selected point's HTTP details. The captures do not reconcile every supplied result with a selectable point, so complete per-result coverage is unverified.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given Ping results are available, when the Ping layer is selected, each supplied result is displayed as a selectable point on the map.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-after-add-ping.png shows Ping map points and criterion-2-final.png shows a selection opening a Ping detail error. Evidence does not reconcile all 30 reported source features with selectable points; full per-result coverage is unverified.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given Video Streaming results are available, when the Video Streaming layer is selected, each supplied result is displayed as a selectable point on the map.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-final.png shows the selected Video Streaming layer with no visible result points. The run records an empty successful points response in the tested area and 90-day range; representative results needed to assess rendering were unavailable.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given details are available for a result point, when the point is selected, a new detail dialog opens for that same result and displays its test type, result time, location, and available network technology/context.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-4-after-add-http.png and criterion-4-final.png show HTTP selection opening test 132412571 with test type, time, 4G service and serving cell. Location and lower technology rows are outside the saved view, so complete common context and point-to-result matching remain inconclusive.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given an HTTP Browsing point is selected and its details are available, the dialog displays that result’s Page Load Time.
criterionOutcomes.reason: After the independent restart and layer addition in criterion-5-before-add-http-restarted.png and criterion-5-after-add-http.png, criterion-5-final.png visibly shows HTTP result 132412571 with Page Load Time (s) 1.535.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a Ping point is selected and its details are available, the dialog displays that result’s Ping Time.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-6-after-add-ping.png shows Ping points; criterion-6-final.png shows 'Unable to load point details.' and Retry, with no Ping Time. The run records repeated HTTP 500 detail responses, leaving the available-details prerequisite unmet.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given a Video Streaming point is selected and its details are available, the dialog displays that result’s Rebuffer Count.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-7-final.png shows the selected Video Streaming layer without result points. The run records an empty points response for the tested area and 90-day range, so no representative selectable result was available to inspect Rebuffer Count.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given an HTTP Browsing result ends in error, when its point is displayed, it is visually distinct from a successful result; a zero Page Load Time on the failed result is not coloured as success.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-8-after-add-http.png shows black square error markers distinct from coloured successful-result markers and a matching Error legend. criterion-8-after-select-error.png and criterion-8-final.png show the selected failed HTTP result 132585390 with Page Load Time 0 and Task TimeOut; the error remains a black square rather than a successful load-time colour.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Given details cannot be returned for a selected point, the user sees a clear no-data or error message and no stale details are displayed.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-9-after-select-valid-http.png shows valid HTTP result 132585862 with Page Load Time 0.801. criterion-9-after-add-ping.png retains that HTTP tab before Ping selection; criterion-9-final.png shows a new active Ping tab with 'Unable to load point details.' and Retry, with no stale HTTP fields displayed.

reason: Reviewed all nine canonical criteria against attempt-001 evidence: 3 Passed, 3 Unverified and 3 Blocked. Video Streaming representative data and available Ping details were unavailable; full HTTP/Ping rendering and complete common-context evidence remain inconclusive.
